title: devdeck workspace
description: workspace.yaml: the folder of repositories devdeck works on, and who owns each one.

name.description: Short name of the workspace: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

root.description: The folder that contains the repositories. Absolute, starting with ~, or relative to this file.

default_connection.description: Id of the connection used by repos that have no rule or override.

hosts.description: Remote machines that run devdeck's agent.

path.description: Folder of the repository, relative to the workspace root.

remote.description: Where it lives, as host/owner/repo (no credentials).

connection.description: Overrides the account rules for this repo.

images.description: Docker images built from this repository.

repository.description: The Docker Hub repository, namespace/name, with no tag: for example acme/demo-api.

dockerfile.description: Relative to the repository. Default: Dockerfile.

context.description: Build context, relative to the repository. Default: .

account.description: A Docker account on this machine to push with, instead of the one that owns the namespace.

secrets.description: Build secrets the Dockerfile asks for. Only where each comes from is written here, never its value.

id.description: What the Dockerfile asks for: RUN --mount=type=secret,id=<id>.

from.description: github: the token of the GitHub account devdeck picks for this repo. keyring: a named build secret saved in your OS keychain.

name.description: For from: keyring, the name it was saved under (the id when left out).

type.description: A plugin's connection type, such as github.

identity.description: The commit identity used with this connection.

settings.description: Non-secret settings such as a host name. Secrets never go in YAML; they live in the OS keychain.

type.description: How devdeck reaches it: aws-ssm opens an SSM port-forwarding session with the AWS CLI.

instance.description: The instance id, such as i-0123456789abcdef0.

profile.description: The AWS CLI profile. Leave out for the default one.

agent_port.description: The agent's port on the host (7071 if left out).

match.description: A remote pattern such as github.com/acme/*.
